hero.name: Burak Tomruk
hero.tagline1: Full-stack developer with a frontend focus, building scalable web products with React and TypeScript. Focused on architecture, performance and reliability.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I have 6+ years of experience building production software across media, enterprise, banking and AI. I work across the stack, with my deepest expertise in React, TypeScript and frontend architecture.
about.p2: I enjoy solving hard product and engineering problems, improving performance and reliability, and helping teams move faster through clear technical decisions, reusable patterns and practical mentoring.

projects.subtitle: Independent products I build outside work — from travel and sports data to subscription tracking and fitness.
projects.showcaseDescription: Four active products, each solving a different problem and showing a different part of how I design, build and ship software.

magnetmiles.summary: Turn the places you've visited into a visual collection of fridge magnets, maps and shareable travel recaps.

coefpulse.summary: See how European match results change a country's UEFA coefficient and ranking race.

subtrackerrr.summary: See what renews next, how much you're spending on subscriptions and which ones may be worth cancelling.

fitvalue.summary: Turn gym attendance and membership cost into a simple answer: keep it, downgrade it or cancel it.

outthere.summary: Find a day trip that fits the time you have and still gets you home when you want.
